payload.summary: Caring Contacts: nothing enforces that a new workspace screen joins the browser spec's WORKSPACE_SCREENS
payload.detail: The design-system adoption generator refuses an undeclared production page route, so adding a screen forces it into the caring-contacts-workspace surface -- whose five proof categories are all declared passed with tests/ui-caring-contacts-workspace.spec.ts as sole evidence. The generator validates that the evidence path is a tracked file, never that the suite visits the route. So a screen added to the surface but not to the spec's WORKSPACE_SCREENS silently re-creates the Critical finding fixed in Task 5 fix round 1: a governance artifact asserting dark, forced-colours, 320px, print and browser proof for a route nothing has visited. Closure: a static check comparing the surface's routes against the spec's screen list, failing when they diverge.
